hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 ETH↔phiETH custom curve swap using beforeSwapReturnsDelta to fully bypass concentrated liquidity. Takes the full input amount, wraps or unwraps via phiEth, and settles the output; no AMM liquidity is involved. Adding liquidity to the pool is permanently blocked, and the hook only accepts ETH/phiETH pools with a zero fee.
